articles.title: Why many Syrians feel Assad's death sentence isn't enough
articles.excerpt: In July, a Syrian court sentenced former dictator Bashar Assad to death for crimes against his own people. But after 14 years of civil war, many survivors are demanding more when it comes to transitional justice.
